_comment: Edit this file to control the reel. Reorder/add/remove entries in 'segments'. Each segment may have a 'card' (title-card text; first line = big title, rest = smaller body) and/or a 'clip' (filename in this folder). To trim a clip, set 'start' and/or 'end' in seconds; omit both to use the whole clip. Anything under keys starting with '_' is ignored by the script.

music._note: Optional. Set 'file' to an audio file in this folder (mp3/m4a/wav) to add a soundtrack; leave it empty to keep the reel silent. 'start' is how many seconds into the track to begin. 'volume' 1.0 = unchanged. 'loop' repeats the track if it is shorter than the reel. 'fade_in'/'fade_out' are in seconds.
